name: Jirina Kudro
description: A leader who took control of Drannith's defenses.

description_citations.text: "Vivien Reid". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kudro orders Lukka confined, but Jirina helps him escape Drannith into Savai.
timeline.quote: Jirina Kudro helped him escape Drannith and flee into Savai

citation.text: "Drannith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leori returns to Drannith with Jirina and is shot down by ballistae, then shackled at the wall.
timeline.quote: She was shot down and wounded

citation.text: "Drannith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Ozolith shatters, igniting Lukka's spark and sending him away, so the monsters wander off.
timeline.quote: causing his planeswalker spark to ignite, sending him away from Ikoria

citation.text: "Drannith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: General Kudro enacts security measures across Drannith after Lukka's betrayal.
timeline.quote: After what he viewed as Lukka's shocking betrayal, General Kudro enacted stringent security measures at every entry point into Drannith.

citation.text: Checkpoint Officer (Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Ozolith pulses and the nightmares turn on the hunters; the great snake drags the skyship Vermilion down while Barrow and Zeph survive.
timeline.quote: The great snake coiled around Vermilion, dragging it down despite the crew's frantic attempts to flee.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph travel with Jirina and Vivien back to Drannith by indirect routes, avoiding Lukka's monsters.
timeline.quote: They kept to indirect routes to avoid Lukka's monsters and the city's civilian population

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina confronts Colonel Bryd, assumes command, and the gates open so Zeph and Barrow enter Drannith.
timeline.quote: After Jirina assumed command, the gates were opened, and Zeph entered the city without incident

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the Citadel war room Barrow, Vivien, Brin and Major Humron join Jirina to plan against Lukka's attack.
timeline.quote: In the Citadel's war room, Barrow, Vivien, Brin, and Major Humron joined her around a map of Drannith to prepare for Lukka's imminent attack.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow agrees the secondary wall cannot be held, calls other bonders, and several arrive by dawn.
timeline.quote: By dawn, Barrow's call had been answered: several bonders and monsters arrived in the city

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka's army comes into view as the Siege of Drannith begins; Barrow and Zeph are held in reserve near the north gate.
timeline.quote: As the sun rose, Lukka's massive army came into view

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Monsters breach the inner city; Barrow and Zeph defeat several intruders before being overwhelmed.
timeline.quote: The pair intercepted and defeated several intruders but were soon overwhelmed by the scale of the incursion.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Barrow and Zeph lead the bonded charge through the main gate to rescue Jirina, turning the tide until Lukka is surrounded.
timeline.quote: Barrow and Zeph were the first to break through the main gate, leading the charge of bonded fighters to rescue her.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the siege, Jirina lets bonders and monsters live in the First Ring and Barrow and Zeph help normalize monsters among people.
timeline.quote: Jirina authorized bonders and their monsters to reside in the First Ring, just outside the city proper.

citation.text: "Barrow and Zeph", section "After the siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka and his winged cat break through and Lukka touches the central Ozolith, pulled into a vision; the Vermilion arrives to retrieve him.
timeline.quote: Lukka touched the glowing crystal

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Johannes shoots Abda dead with the Vermilion's ballistae while Jirina observes.
timeline.quote: managed to land a fatal shot on Abda

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A nightmare snake brings down the Vermilion, killing Rigi, Falk and Johannes; Jirina sees Lukka in the Ozolith and Leori carries her away.
timeline.quote: while the Vermillion crashed to the ground, killing Rigi, Falk, and Johannes

citation.text: "Battle at the Ozolith", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brin and Roland enter Drannith with Jirina's group after Colonel Bryd is relieved of command.
timeline.quote: Once Bryd was relieved of command, Brin and Roland were accepted into the city

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The defenders plan Drannith's defense in the Citadel war room, and Brin reports that other bonders are on their way.
timeline.quote: She announced that Vheen and other bonders had heard Barrow's magical broadcast and were on their way.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Siege of Drannith begins at sunrise as Lukka's army appears.
timeline.quote: as the Siege of Drannith started.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Monsters breach the inner city and Brin relays Barrow's warnings to Jirina.
timeline.quote: some flyers and burrowers had bypassed the walls and were attacking civilians

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien's summoned monstrosaur turns the battle and the bonders encircle Lukka, ending the assault.
timeline.quote: the bonders encircled Lukka and brought the assault to a close.

citation.text: "Brin and Roland", section "Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kudro imprisons Lukka; Jirina helps him escape by faking her kidnapping and Vivien scares off his pursuers.
timeline.quote: Jirina helps Lukka escape by faking her kidnapping.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "Outcast". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka and Vivien find the winged tiger and learn the Ozolith is forcing monsters to attack Drannith; they escape the hunters on the tiger.
timeline.quote: they escape by riding the winged tiger.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "Pursuit". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Ozolith Lukka connects his mind to the crystal, commands the Nightmares against the hunters and turns on Vivien and the bonders.
timeline.quote: Lukka commands all the Nightmares to attack the hunters, which leads to the pirates fleeing.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "The battle at the Ozolith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The winged tiger saves Jirina and is shot and captured at Drannith; Jirina refuses to execute it.
timeline.quote: Jirina is ordered to perform the execution but refuses.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "Marching on Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka stabs General Kudro to death at a parley; Jirina refuses to assassinate Lukka and flees into a river.
timeline.quote: He stabs General Kudro to death himself.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "The death of Kudro". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien and a bonder rescue Jirina, who takes control of Drannith's defenses.
timeline.quote: Jirina ends up taking control of the city's defenses

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "The Siege of Drannith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Drannith rebuilds with more tolerance for bonders; Jirina becomes a colonel.
timeline.quote: Jirina is a colonel now.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond
citation.text: "Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — Sundered Bond", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Battle at the Ozolith Lukka touches the crystal, gains great but unbalanced power, forms an army of beasts and kills General Kudro, and Jirina attacks him and flees.
timeline.quote: As Kudro refused to listen, Lukka killed him.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka's army attacks Drannith in the Siege of Drannith but Jirina's strategy and the bonders turn the tide.
timeline.quote: Lukka and his army attacked the city, starting the Siege of Drannith

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina returns to Drannith, deposes Colonel Bryd and takes command with Vivien and the bonders.
timeline.quote: assuming de facto command after successfully deposing Colonel Bryd

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "Prelude". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina holds a war council and the First Ring is evacuated; Barrow calls other bonders to help.
timeline.quote: the First Ring was evacuated to consolidate defenses within the main wall

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "Defense Preparations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka's army arrives at the northern gate at dawn and breaches the walls, forcing Jirina to deploy the bonders.
timeline.quote: At dawn, Lukka's army

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "The Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina confronts Lukka on Yidaro's shell; he refuses to stop and she leaps to safety as the Ozolith surges.
timeline.quote: Lukka refused and tried to force more power from the Ozolith.

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "The Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The bonders charge through the gates, rescue Jirina and turn the tide; Vivien summons a monstrosaur to distract Lukka.
timeline.quote: rescuing Jirina and turning the tide of the battle

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "The Siege". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The leaderless monsters scatter; afterwards Jirina becomes colonel and bonded humans and monsters may live in the First Ring.
timeline.quote: Jirina officially took the rank of colonel.

citation.text: "Siege of Drannith", section "Ignition and Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina Kudro and Mzed's hunters arrive in Skysail by balloon seeking a vessel to catch Leori.
timeline.quote: arrived in Skysail looking for a vessel that could catch up to the flying patagia tiger Leori

citation.text: "Skysail", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The hunters see Narset buying books and book a flight on the Vermillion.
timeline.quote: After witnessing Narset buying a huge stack of books

citation.text: "Skysail", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vivien and the bonders join Jirina's defense of Drannith; Lukka overloads the Ozolith, igniting his spark, and planeswalks away.
timeline.quote: This caused his planeswalker's spark to ignite , and he planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina Kudro warns that the bonders know everything.
timeline.quote: The bonders work with creatures that fly, slink, and burrow. Assume they know everything.

citation.text: Reconnaissance Mission (Crimson Vow Commander, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jirina leads Drannith's survivors along the terror road toward Lavabrink while Colonel Bryd urges sending soldiers ahead.
timeline.quote: Perhaps it would be wise to send a detachment of soldiers ahead, to prepare Lavabrink for our arrival.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Bryd questions trusting Vivien, and Jirina rejects his suspicion; then an attack on the column begins.
timeline.quote: I won't have you discarding one of our strongest on baseless paranoia!

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian cats attack Jirina's Coppercoats and Jirina kills one with her sword.
timeline.quote: almost severing the head entirely

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A tigorilla and Haldan save Jirina from a second cat, and the tigorilla's crystals burn off Phyrexian oil.
timeline.quote: the Phyrexian oil bubbled and hissed, turning to a sickly black smoke

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jirina sees Vivien's green signals and knows the ambush failed and Lukka is still coming.
timeline.quote: That was the signal. They had failed. Lukka was still coming.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jirina deliberately changes the column's course to a path that does not lead to Lavabrink, silencing Haldan's warning about whose territory it is.
timeline.quote: If you want to make it to nightfall alive, you'll say nothing.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The refugees enter a basin of volcanic glass with no exit, realizing they are not at Lavabrink.
timeline.quote: there seemed to be no other road or pass out.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian Lukka climbs into the basin and announces in a thousand voices that Drannith's prodigal son has returned to offer Phyrexian unity.
timeline.quote: DRANNITH! TRAITOR-CITY! YOUR PRODIGAL SON HAS RETURNED FOR YOU.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Jirina watches Vadrok toss Lukka's corpse aside and burn what remains of the titan.
timeline.quote: So passes the captain of the Specials

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vivien steps in front of the survivors to keep Vadrok from attacking them, and Vadrok flies away.
timeline.quote: Then it was aloft again

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Haldan and the crowd accuse Jirina of using them as bait, and Jirina defends that she had no other way.
timeline.quote: In war, there are no certainties,

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Vivien tells the survivors to survive what is coming, as another Phyrexian branch descends behind the mountains.
timeline.quote: A branch, Vivien had called them

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Ikoria is targeted in the New Phyrexian Invasion and Vivien arranges its defense with Chevill and Jirina Kudro.
timeline.quote: Vivien took to arranging the defense of Ikoria alongside Chevill and Jirina Kudro .

citation.text: "Ikoria", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina bluffs and leads the survivors and Lukka into Vadrok's lair, where Vadrok's fire destroys him and Vivien's arrows and Vadrok finish him.
timeline.quote: Vadrok's magical fire obliterated Lukka's massive form

citation.text: "Lukka", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrok rips Lukka from his flesh-titan, and Lukka is burned and finished off by Vivien.
timeline.quote: Lukka was then burned by Vadrok's ethereal fire and finished off by Vivien

citation.text: "New Phyrexian Invasion", section "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the invasion Vivien helps defend Ikoria; Vadrok rips Lukka from his flesh-titan and Vivien finishes him with three spectral arrows.
timeline.quote: She finished the apex monster's work, planting three spectral arrows in Lukka's chest.

citation.text: "Vivien Reid", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina's and Lukka's forces clash at the Ozolith and Leori saves her.
timeline.quote: she was ultimately saved by his bonded tiger, Leori

citation.text: "Jirina Kudro", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka kills General Kudro; Jirina refuses to join him, attacks him and flees to command Drannith's defenses.
timeline.quote: Lukka killed him

citation.text: "Jirina Kudro", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina takes over command from Colonel Bryd.
timeline.quote: Jirina successfully took over command of Drannith's forces from Colonel Bryd

citation.text: "Jirina Kudro", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka is surrounded by bonders; his use of the Ozolith makes it explode and ignites his spark.
timeline.quote: resulting in his planeswalker's spark igniting

citation.text: "Jirina Kudro", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina survives the sacking of Drannith and leads survivors to Lavabrink with Vivien and Chevill.
timeline.quote: Jirina, survived Lukka's sacking of Drannith, leading the survivors to Lavabrink

citation.text: "Jirina Kudro", section "Invasion of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrok rips Lukka from his flesh-titan and Jirina dissuades Vadrok from attacking the survivors.
timeline.quote: Jirina dissuaded Vadrok from subsequently attacking the survivors

citation.text: "Jirina Kudro", section "Invasion of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leori rescues Jirina from Falk's skyship at Lukka's bidding.
timeline.quote: Lukka bid her rescue Jirina from Falk 's skyship, which she did

citation.text: "Leori", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Leori is pierced by ballista bolts delivering Jirina to Drannith but survives.
timeline.quote: Leori was pierced in several places, but survived.

citation.text: "Leori", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: General Kudro kills Leori; her last act is to comfort Lukka through the bond.
timeline.quote: Kudro then took the matter into his own hands.

citation.text: "Leori", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jirina Kudro leads Drannith survivors into Vadrok's lair to lure in Lukka.
timeline.quote: Jirina Kudro led a column of survivors from the destroyed city of Drannith into Vadrok's lair

citation.text: "Vadrok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrok turns to the citizens but declines to attack and departs.
timeline.quote: declined to attack and departed

citation.text: "Vadrok", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
